text:
Alyssa: Heads up — we're deploying egress hardening in eu-west-1 at 10:30 UTC. This will tighten outbound firewall rules to only allow privatelink + keystore endpoints. Quick sanity check: any services that talk to external S3 or metrics endpoints in that region?
Ben: Noted. gpu-autoscaler talks to keystore and to our metrics-exporter (internal). The metrics exporter uses an external metrics proxy (metrics-redir.company.net) — will that be allowed?
Alyssa: Good catch. Policy currently allows privatelink endpoints + 10.0.0.0/8. metrics-redir is a private ALB in the VPC?
Ben: It's cross-account ALB with privatelink endpoint yes. But the keystore KMS traffic spikes during node boot — last time tighten we saw throttles.
Sofia: Re: KMS QPS — we still have the client-side retry/backoff, but the boot path does synchronous decrypts. If KMS is slow the node bootstrap blocks and gpu nodes sit in Pending for minutes.
Kevin: If autoscaler probes fail for node readiness because metrics can't post, the scaler won't count the node and we underprovision. That caused the 4x latency spike last month.
Marta: Ops proposal — allow privatelink endpoints for metrics, keystore, and add a short exception for sts.amazonaws.com for bootstrap path. Then revoke after warmup window (15m). Thoughts? :thinking_face: 
Ben: Sounds reasonable. We should also add a guard in autoscaler to accept nodes once kubelet reaches Ready even if metrics not yet reported. Small change.
Alyssa: I'll scope the firewall rule: allow outbound to privatelink-ids: [pl-ks-001, pl-metrics-22], and add egress exception to sts for 10.30-10.45 UTC only. Then remove.
deploy-bot: rollout scheduled by Alyssa for 2026-03-20T10:30:00Z. Change set: FW-EGRESS-HARDEN-2026-03-20.
Sofia: Also watch KMS RequestRateExceeded alerts. If we see >1000/s we'll pause and rollback.
Kevin: Adding a short circuit: autoscaler change queued — if node join takes >6m fallback to increase desired capacity by 10% to cover boot delays.
Marta: Can we record an audit log marker? We should tag the change so we can correlate S3/audit spikes with this rollout.
Alyssa: Yep — will annotate the change in the audit stream and add an alert runbook link. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/firewall-egress-hardening
Ben: One more: quota for privatelink endpoints per subnet — if we hit ENI allocation limits during mass boot we could leak. Recommend pre-warming 20 endpoints.
Sofia: I'll queue a small warm-pool prewarm for eu-west-1 GPUs + monitor keystore latency histograms.
Alyssa: OK executing: deploying rule in 5m, prewarm nodes now, autoscaler tweak to be applied post-deploy. Ping here if anything flares. :rocket:
